import time
from collections import OrderedDict


class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, maxsize, ttl=None):
        if maxsize < 1:
            raise ValueError("maxsize must be >= 1")
        self.maxsize = maxsize
        self.ttl = ttl  # default seconds-to-live; None = never expires
        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at or None)

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        item = self._data.get(key)
        if item is None:
            return default
        value, expires_at = item
        if expires_at is not None and expires_at <= time.monotonic():
            del self._data[key]
            return default
        self._data.move_to_end(key)
        return value

    def put(self, key, value, ttl=None):
        ttl = self.ttl if ttl is None else ttl
        expires_at = None if ttl is None else time.monotonic() + ttl
        self._data[key] = (value, expires_at)
        self._data.move_to_end(key)
        # ponytail: expired entries are only dropped lazily on get, so a dead
        # entry can outlive a live LRU one. Add an expiry heap if that matters.
        if len(self._data) > self.maxsize:
            self._data.popitem(last=False)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self._data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("b", 2)
    assert c.get("a") == 1          # a is now most recent
    c.put("c", 3)                   # evicts b
    assert c.get("b") is None and c.get("a") == 1 and c.get("c") == 3
    c.put("a", 10)                  # overwrite, no eviction
    assert len(c) == 2 and c.get("a") == 10

    c.put("x", 1, ttl=0)            # per-entry ttl, already expired
    assert c.get("x", "gone") == "gone" and "x" not in c._data

    t = LRUCache(2, ttl=0.05)       # default ttl
    t.put("k", "v")
    t.put("forever", "v", ttl=float("inf"))
    assert t.get("k") == "v"
    time.sleep(0.06)
    assert t.get("k") is None and t.get("forever") == "v"
    print("ok")

`get` and `put` are both O(1) on top of `OrderedDict`. The TTL is set per entry via `put(..., ttl=seconds)`, falling back to the constructor's `ttl`, and `ttl=float("inf")` opts a single entry out of a default.
